PREVIOUS_RESULT_229DG: Seven scalar maps e,x,y,U,V,z,R on the exact four-square positive physical Stage37 source each have uniform B^o fixed-value endpoint fibers. For fixed U, first e²+x²=U² then (V−z)(V+z)=e²−x²≠0 provide divisor-bound representations; others by cyclic square equations, 229BS fixed e/R. With retained 229BQ uniform prescribed-radical support, the entire min_{seven}rad(t)<=Z sector has O(Z B^o)=B^(1/3−delta/2+o)=o(B^(1/3)) at the EXISTING Z=B^(1/3−delta/2). Thus HARD13 may add simultaneously rad(e),rad(x),rad(y),rad(U),rad(V),rad(z),rad(R)>Z and t>Z at one power-saved union cost. This is a SCOPED new sector elimination, not an independent density factor or a full occupied-support count. CARD_DOC_ID=1AwPJuG70gFc6ahk2qUwINpWLRoa-WIWudekRbMjm8SE.
PREVIOUS_RESULT_229DF: For every p>3, k>=1, the p-primitive gap-cone congruences F=ABv+AC+BvC−2d²=0, N_an=0, OmegaPi=0 (mod p^k) have exactly 24 phi(p^k) solutions for p==1 or19 mod24 and zero otherwise. 229DE twelve single-gap-zero lines and twelve single-pair-sum-zero lines lift by Hensel with unique root parameters and arbitrary unit scale. Finite checks (7,13,19,31,43,73,97 k1/2;19 k3) PASS. This is local necessary cone geometry ONLY, not physical full selectors, not realized modulus support, not a one-third endpoint estimate. Higher powers of these SAME equations provide no new cone obstruction; physical selector/height input needed. CARD_DOC_ID=19ipW9gfke0bDg-rOq0IsbRDSnDdsz4CyVeyz5HJvbpY.
PREVIOUS_RESULT_229DE: For odd p>3, on the cone ABv+AC+BvC=2d² with N_an=0 and OmegaPi=0, the nonzero finite-field locus is exactly 24 projective points (12 one-gap-zero and 12 one-pair-sum-zero), equivalently 24(p−1) nonzero vectors, iff p==1 or19 mod24; otherwise empty. (-2/p) and (-3/p) split data are correlated, not independent savings. This is a local NECESSARY incidence theorem only; no proof of global physical lifting, occupied-support counting, or new exponent. Card 1Nq_30LdRyuPZMmQoWu5Ned1P8FfVd2_c2XDRDlMaSYs.
PREVIOUS_RESULT_229DD: For odd p>3 dividing BOTH N_an=S²−6d² and K_cross=rad_odd(Omega Pi), 229CW q=gcd(S,d), gcd(q,OmegaPi)=1 forces p∤d and (S/d)²==6 modp. Combine 229DC p==1mod3/M_i-only localization to obtain p==1 or19mod24, excluding p==7,13mod24. PHYSICAL-ONLY: 229CW q primes1mod12 => 3∤gcd(S,d); the cone gap-square identity then forces 3|N_an iff3|S iff3|J and v3(N_an)=1 (N_an==3mod9). A primitive cone fixture q=3 disproves this iff outside the full physical q restriction. Let M24 be the matched M_U M_V M_z radical restricted to p==1 or19mod24; exact PHYSICAL gcd(N_an,K_cross)=gcd(N_an,3*M24). Finite cone/modular checks PASS; NO selector-aware occupied count, credit0, gate/authority/HOLD unchanged.
